assessment.combination: One out, all out: any declining component wins. Otherwise all components must be known; any improvement wins, else stable.
assessment.area_policy: Conservative overlap bounds; unassessable area stays unknown. Colors mark any known declining portion; otherwise incomplete cells stay gray.
assessment.land_cover_policy: Pinned UNCCD default matrix; baseline-to-current transitions. Not a locally validated ecological judgement.

productivity.series: Observed starting NDVI before edits, followed by annual model outputs. Not historical observations.
productivity.trajectory: Linear slope and pinned Mann–Kendall 95% table through 60 samples; longer series use a continuity-corrected normal approximation with conservative untied variance. Available from 10 annual samples. Statistical significance describes the synthetic series, not forecast confidence.
productivity.state: Fixed first 10 samples (2021–2030) versus latest 3 non-overlapping samples; available from 2033. Extended baseline percentiles, ±2 class threshold, 0.01 NDVI deadband.
productivity.performance: Mean over the elapsed simulation / scene-local 90th percentile for the same initial dominant land cover; ≤0.5 declines. Groups stay fixed, benchmarks use the same elapsed period. No soil taxonomy; any open-water history and nonpositive benchmarks unknown.
productivity.limitations: Scenario adaptation, not identical Trends.Earth outputs. Early interventions affect the simulated reference period. No historical NDVI is invented; no local ecological validation.

stories.title: Keep the starting landscape
stories.story: Control: time alone must not create carbon or vegetation changes.

stories.title: Clear a forest patch
stories.story: Land-cover decline appears immediately; carbon loss grows over time.

stories.title: Restore an artificial-area cell
stories.story: Vegetation and carbon rise; green appears once all three components can be assessed.

stories.title: Clear, then restore after ten years
stories.story: Restoring the cover does not undo accumulated carbon loss. Recovery takes time.

stories.title: Replace forest with grass
stories.story: The combined map can decline while soil carbon stays unchanged: the cover matrix matters.

stories.title: Convert forest to cropland
stories.story: The assumed agricultural carbon factor produces a slower loss than clearing to artificial area.

stories.title: Plant where soil data is missing
stories.story: NDVI can improve without enough evidence to mark the combined map green.

stories.title: Replace the patch with water
stories.story: Open water is outside the terrestrial productivity model; lower NDVI is not evidence of failed aquatic vegetation.

productivity.unavailable_reason: Open-water history is outside this terrestrial productivity model.
